chunks: 58 – Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Nu'man, Ibn Abi Tariifa, al-Bajali, client of al-Ahwal, Abu Ja'far. Kufan. He is nicknamed 'Mu'min al-Taq'. He has the book 'Do, Do Not Do', a large, good book.

key_terms.افْعَلْ لَا تَفْعَلْ: If'al La Taf'al (Do, Do Not Do), the title of his book
key_terms.مُؤْمِنُ الطَّاقِ: Mu'min al-Taq (Believer of the Niche), a nickname for the narrator

ai.seo_question: Who is Ibn Abi Tariifa and what is his notable book?
ai.summary: This entry provides a biographical sketch of the narrator Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Nu'man, known as Ibn Abi Tariifa. It highlights his lineage, tribal affiliation, residence in Kufa, his nickname 'Mu'min al-Taq' (Believer of the Niche), and notes his authorship of a significant book titled 'If'al La Taf'al' (Do, Do Not Do).
